_about: Meaning, unit and kind of each signal column, in CSV header order (source_row and timestamp are not signals). Meaning and unit come from the UCI page as supplied by the owner; null means not supplied yet, never filled from memory. kind comes from the data (PLAN.md decision 2). Every entry stays verified:false until the owner confirms it.
kind_basis: on_off = exactly two distinct values, 0.0 and 1.0, over the whole CSV (explore_data.py, step 1.3b); continuous = any other column. Owner's rule, 2026-10-19.

TP3.meaning: pressure generated at the pneumatic panel (system pressure the train uses)
TP3.source: UCI page variable table, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Motor_current.meaning: motor current; states: about 0 A off, 4 A offloaded, 7 A under load, 9 A starting
Motor_current.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

MPG.meaning: starts the compressor under load when pressure drops below 8.2 bar
MPG.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19
